chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
On the grave of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), at the time of his burial:
ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali say over the Prophet's grave at the time of burial?
ai.summary: This passage marks the immediate, private grief of Imam Ali (peace be upon him) at the Prophet's grave, distinct from the public composure maintained during the funeral prayers. It highlights the unique bond between the Imam and the Prophet, serving as a foundational moment for understanding the spiritual and emotional weight of the Prophet's departure in Shia tradition.

en.sayed-ali-raza: 292. Amīr al-mu’minīn, peace be upon him, said
on the grave of the Messenger of Allāh, peace be upon him and his descendants, at the time of burial:
